topics.topic: Whether an integer port outside 1–65535 must prevent startup
questions: Must a port whose value has integer form but lies outside 1 to 65535 end the start?
Must PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT values outside 1 through 65535 end the start, even though they have the row's declared int form?
Must a port that parses as an integer but lies outside 1 to 65535 end the start, as A8 requires, or does its integer form suffice?

quotes:
The port is a whole number from 1 to 65535, and a time zone the time zone database does not know ends the
start:

A connections file that condition 1 of A5 rule 7 rejects, a run setting that A8 refuses, or a token file that A5
rule 2 rejects ends the start.
judgement.why: A8 excludes every port outside 1 through 65535, and the service-start flow expressly says that any run setting A8 refuses ends the start.

topics.topic: Whether an unknown time-zone name must prevent startup
questions: Must a syntactically valid string naming a time zone unknown to the time-zone database end the start?
Must a syntactically valid string that is not known by the time zone database end the start, as A8 requires?
Must a syntactically valid string naming no known time zone end the start, as A8 requires, or is it accepted because its form is str?

quotes: A port above 65535, an unknown time zone or an invalid connections file ends the start.
judgement.why: The load_config error contract explicitly requires an unknown time zone to end startup.
